text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, Bright! Are you warming up for
practice?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Hanshin Daishoten is fast
approaching, so I must prepare.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Isn't Spe also participating in that race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as a warm-up to the spring Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we'll finally get to see what
the
Golden Generation's
Derby Umamusume is
made of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I happened to watch her last race. Her
form was most impressive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However...
This is not the time to focus on
my opponents. I must hone
my own senses
and skills.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: True, Bright here is the winner of last year's Hanshin Daishoten and spring Tenno Sho, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And as champion, I must demonstrate that
my victory was inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, you certainly have the mindset of a
champion down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we should get to training. See ya
later, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Have a lovely day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Special Week... Your opponent
shows no signs of weakness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's next race steadily
approaches. We should be
perfecting our
strategy and fine-tuning her form by now,
but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A little run like that doesn't usually
tire
you out.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-sorry...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you take a break and try again?
Practice makes power,
right? Or, you
know, something like that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right, that sounds good...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her mind constantly on Silence
Suzuka, Special Week hasn't
been able to
concentrate on practice at all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Tazuna? Can I help you with something?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can. Twinkle Monthly would like to
speak with you. It seems they
want to run a
special feature on Team Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho-HO! Twinkle Monthly sure has
some GREAT taste!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A special feature on us? That'd be
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they also gave us a survey for your
team members to fill out. I'll
be sure to
send that to your office.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Thank you, I really appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And one more thing... There's a former
trainer with overseas
experience visiting
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I happened to mention Silence Suzuka,
and they seemed interested in
seeing her
run today.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That would be super helpful. I'd love to
get some insight.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Well, Suzuka? What do you think? Want
to show off a bit to this
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, um, uh... sorry, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trainer Tazuna mentioned has come to
observe Silence Suzuka, so
I'm currently
having her show off her skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the stands to watch over them
and find Special Week
likewise staring at
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I don't know what came over me.
I can't believe I almost
tried to stop
Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No, I understand. You and Suzuka have
been together ever since you
entered the
academy.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No, I understand. You and Suzuka have
been together ever since you
entered the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I still remember that day so clearly—
the
day I first saw Suzuka run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'd just arrived from Hokkaido. Just as I
was starting to worry I'd made
a mistake
coming here, I saw her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The way she ran was just so
awe-inspiring. I
couldn't look away.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I've watched her run,
hoping I could run like that...
someday...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week trails off, leaving us both
standing in silence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure even she wasn't aware of just how
much motivation she got
from watching
Silence Suzuka run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch Silence Suzuka run down the
track...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember the first time I saw her run.
She
looked like she was
having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, she found her own running
style, and the more people
saw her run,
the more expectations for her swelled.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Spe... you said you want to run like
Suzuka, correct?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
So, what exactly is it that you love about
her running?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't it obvious? I mean, it's so...
pretty and cool...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And it makes you dream, doesn't it? You
can't help but wonder what
her next race
will be like.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly! And every single time, she just blows you away!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to see her race again
and
again! Like at the Osaka
Hai! Or maybe a
second Takarazuka Kinen win! Or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Seeking out new scenery is Suzuka's
dream.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
When she runs, that's what she's chasing.
And that steadfast drive of
hers is what we
fell in love with.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
When she runs, that's what she's chasing.
And that steadfast drive of
hers is what we
fell in love with.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But you know... once she goes abroad, I
think we'll see a run we love
even more.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But you know... once she goes abroad, I
think we'll see a run we love
even more.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're right... In fact, I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka's running will take her farther than ever before! Farther than anything we could ever imagine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's what I love about her running...
If I
tried to stop her, it wouldn't
be the same
anymore!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And if you want to run like her—to catch
up to her—then you'll need
to work hard.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And if you want to run like her—to catch
up to her—then you'll need
to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Right!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The stands are packed here at the Hanshin
Racecourse, and every moment that ticks
by just makes the crowd more excited for
the race
to come!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And two of the favorites to win are the
Golden Generation's Special
Week and
last year's champion Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here at the Hanshin Daishoten, they will
clash for the very first time!
Just who will
come out on top?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Rain means a muddy track...
I'll need to be
extra careful to not use
too much stamina.
Don't wanna overdo it in the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good, keep thinking like that. The
weather will slow down the pace,
so you
should be able to sit near the front.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right, okay... I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The 3,000-meter course at Hanshin has a
short stretch with an uphill.
Once you hit
the third corner, turn on the gas!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I can't tell if you're being serious, or
if you're messing with me...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell ya mean?! You can't spell Hanshin
Daishoten without "Gold
Ship!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Instead of spouting your nonsense, focus
on making your debut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, what rotten luck. I can't believe
Suzuka's flight was scheduled
for the same
time as the race...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, actually, that was my idea. I wanted
her to leave today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If Suzuka's going to run overseas
worry-free... I need to show her that
I can
win, even if she's not by my side!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well then, you better seize
victory in today's race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you've got all of us behind you
today. Make us proud.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you've got all of us behind you
today. Make us proud.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay, you got it!
